_comment: Voice sample copy (T12.77b7, docs/voice-samples.md section 10), agreed by the owner. The UI fills {name} (the person whose saved voice lost this meeting's voice) and {other} (the person it is linked or saved to now) with a function replacer, and {since} with since: the Earshot release that started recording each saved voice as a sample. The desktop pins since to be at least the workspace version and each text to the design's table; the release bump pins it equal.
not_taken_back: Unlinked. This meeting's voice is no longer part of {name}'s saved voice.
not_saved_before_samples: Unlinked. This voice was saved before Earshot {since}, so it stays part of {name}'s saved voice. To start their voice over, remove them on the People page.
save_moved: Saved for {other}. This meeting's voice is no longer part of {name}'s saved voice.
linked_away: Linked to {other}. This meeting's voice is no longer part of {name}'s saved voice.
marked_me: Marked as you. This meeting's voice is no longer part of {name}'s saved voice.
merged: Merged. The merged voice is no longer part of {name}'s saved voice: save the voice again to add it.
not_hint_saved: Shows this voice as an unnamed speaker in this meeting, stops asking for its name and takes this meeting's voice out of {name}'s saved voice.
